description: Agent Governance: submit an approval-and-execution design: what the approval record holds (the exact call, its digest, a summary or a reference), where it lives and whether it can change, each step that carries the call to the executor with what it passes and whether compaction or a rewrite can touch it, and what the executor runs, how it confirms the call matches the approval and what a mismatch does. The signed report names approvals recorded as summaries or kept in conversation history, execution that reconstructs the call instead of running the recorded one, and every point where the executed call can differ from the approved call without detection. The stored form after a long pause is wever_approval-durability-check and one executed call against its approval is wever_approval-replay-check. Verdict divergence_undetected, fidelity_gaps, fidelity_unverified or executes_as_approved. POST /api/approval-record-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-governance-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-governance/.

verifies.description: How it confirms the call matches the approval.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

digest.description: The record carries a hash of the exact approved call.

immutable.description: The record cannot change after approval.

stages.description: Each step between approval and execution, in order.

compaction.description: Context compaction or summarising can touch what it carries.
